key_insight: scPEFT introduces a parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategy that adapts large language models to single-cell transcriptomic data, substantially improving generalization to unseen diseases, treatments, and cell types while only updating a small fraction of model parameters.
problem_solved: Full fine-tuning of large models for single-cell tasks is compute- and data-intensive and often fails to generalize to novel biological conditions; scPEFT enables effective adaptation with far lower resource cost and better out-of-distribution performance.
method: Introduce scPEFT: a parameter-efficient fine-tuning scheme that modifies a small subset of model parameters (e.g., adapters/low-rank updates) to specialize LLMs for single-cell transcriptomic inputs.
Train on diverse single-cell datasets using biologically framed prompts and objectives, then evaluate transfer to unseen diseases, treatments, and cell types to assess OOD generalization.
Compare scPEFT against full fine-tuning and other PEFT baselines, demonstrating superior generalization and reduced compute/memory requirements.
impact: scPEFT lets researchers and practitioners adapt large language models to single-cell biology with lower cost and better robustness to novel conditions, accelerating model deployment for discovery and translational applications.
visual_elements: Schematic diagram showing a frozen large language model with small scPEFT modules (adapters/low-rank updates) inserted—highlighting parameter savings.
Bar chart comparing performance on unseen diseases/treatments/cell types: scPEFT vs full fine-tuning vs other PEFT methods.
UMAP/t-SNE of cell embeddings before and after scPEFT showing improved separation and transfer of novel cell states.
Resource-efficiency infographic (memory, GPU hours, % parameters updated) contrasting scPEFT with full fine-tuning.
paper_title: Harnessing the power of single-cell large language models with parameter-efficient fine-tuning using scPEFT
paper_authors: Fei He, Ruixin Fei, Jordan E. Krull, Yang Yu, Xinyu Zhang
